title: Eleven Stalls and a Spreadsheet
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：market　|　正文 381 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 market 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Market, my mother said, is a word people use when they do not want to say customers. My mother ran a stall in the ① market for twenty-six years, and for the first twenty she refused to write anything down. What she had instead was a memory for faces and a rule about Tuesday. The ② market for what she sold — cheap, cheerful, and gone by eleven — was never large, and she knew it, and she never once tried to make it larger.

I helped from the age of ten. My job on ③ market days was the change, and my job the rest of the week was a spreadsheet, which I built at fourteen and which she never looked at. The numbers said the ④ market was moving: the coach parties had stopped coming in 2003, and the flats behind the square had brought two hundred people who shopped at seven in the evening.

She was unmoved. 'You can ⑤ market anything once,' she said, 'and then you have to be the thing you sold.' What she meant was that a ⑥ market is not a crowd but a set of promises, and the promises are made one Saturday at a time, in weather, to people who will remember if you are not there.

In 2011 the council redeveloped the square. The old site had been put ⑦ on the market in 2010 and sold in eleven days. The new market was designed by somebody who had clearly never stood in one: eleven glass stalls, a ⑧ market rent nobody on the old site could pay, and a rule about canopies that made half the produce illegal. Six of the eleven stalls were empty within a year, and the ⑨ market rate for a pitch has been cut three times since.

My mother retired in 2014 and died in 2019. The spreadsheet is still on my laptop and still useless. The market, she would have said, is only ever the people who came last week. What I have from her is a piece of advice I did not want at the time: the ⑩ market will always tell you what it wants, and it will tell you late, and the only people who hear it early are the ones who were there on the Tuesdays when nobody came.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 市场；集市（实体场所）
B. n. （对某类商品的）需求；销路
C. v. 推销；营销（market sth）
D. n. 市场（抽象的买卖双方整体）
E. n. 市场（指某一行业界）
F. n. 市价；行情（market rate/rent/price）
G. adj. 集市的；营业日的（market day）
H. 固定搭配：on the market 在售；上市

items.q: ran a stall in the market
The market for what she sold
The numbers said the market was moving
a market is not a crowd but a set of promises
a market rent nobody on the old site could pay
the market rate for a pitch has been cut three times
the market will always tell you what it wants

answers.why: 指实体的“集市、市场”，说母亲在里面摆了二十六年摊。
market for 意为“对……的需求、销路”，说她卖的那些东西销路从来不大。
market day 意为“集市日、营业日”，说赶集日我的活是找零。
指抽象的“市场”（买卖双方整体），说数据表明市场在变化。
market 作动词，意为“推销、营销”，说任何东西都能推销一次。
同样指抽象的“市场”，说市场不是一群人而是一组承诺。
put sth on the market 意为“把……挂牌出售／上市”，说旧场地2010年被挂牌，十一天就卖了。
market rent 意为“市场租金、市价租金”，说老摊主付不起。
market rate 意为“市价、行情”，说摊位市价后来降了三次。
此处 market 拟人化，指“市场界、买卖这一行”，说它总会告诉你它要什么。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 market 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My mother ran a stall in the market for twenty-six years and refused to write anything down.
The market for what she sold was never large, and she never tried to make it larger.
My job on market days was the change, and the numbers said the market was moving.
'You can market anything once,' she said, 'and then you have to be the thing you sold.'
The new market had a market rent nobody on the old site could pay, and six stalls were empty within a year.
